---
title: "Custom Package Test"
filters:
  - shinylive
---

This page tests whether a project-owned wheel can be installed in a Quarto
Shinylive app via `requirements.txt`.

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
## file: app.py
from shiny import App, ui
from embed_demo_pkg import get_message

app = App(
    ui.page_fluid(
        ui.h2("custom wheel install test"),
        ui.p(get_message()),
    ),
    None,
)

## file: requirements.txt
./wheels/embed_demo_pkg-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
```
